name: Kochi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a red hexagonal rosette of paired strokes.
history: The flag of Kochi bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Kochi municipal emblem — a red hexagonal rosette of paired strokes
features.symbolism: the kana コーチ arranged in a ring
